projectDescription: A retro arcade-themed personal developer portfolio built as a React SPA with pixel-art aesthetics, animated page transitions, and a gamified presentation of projects, skills, and writing.
keyFeatures: Retro arcade aesthetic with scanline effects, neon glow, and pixel fonts
7 gamified 'levels' for Home, About, Projects, Skills, Writing, Case Studies, and Contact
Animated page transitions using Framer Motion
Project cartridge cards with 3D hover effects and category filtering
Interactive skill constellation map with animated star-field background
Comic-book style strategy guide layout for blog/writing posts
Arcade-cabinet-style contact form with initials entry screen
Boss-rush case study page with animated battle log narrative
Hash-based routing for static hosting compatibility
Tailwind CSS with custom arcade color palette and font utilities
publicApiSurface: LevelLayout component (wraps each page with loading animation)
ProjectCard component (3D arcade cabinet cartridge card)
Route /skills — Skills (Level 4: Skill Tree / Constellation Map)
Custom Tailwind colors: arcade, purple-deep, purple-electric, magenta-hot, lime-neon, text-offwhite
Custom Tailwind fonts: font-arcade (Press Start 2P), font-pixel (VT323), font-mono (Space Mono)
